cache_configuration_policy: Explicit I1/D1/LL geometry avoids incorrect CPUID auto-detection. Defaults match this baseline host's cpu2 sysfs geometry; override for another host. Intermediate L2 is not modeled by Cachegrind. Matching sizes/ways does not make the basic simulation a native hardware-counter measurement.

constraints: Use no-space symlink, because loader splits LD_PRELOAD at spaces even if VALGRIND_LIB is properly quoted.
Use valgrind.bin to avoid unquoted exec in distro shell wrapper.
Profilers run slowly and change timing; use native unprofiled runs for wall/CPU/RSS and wall contribution estimates.
Cachegrind provides simulated cache/branch events, not hardware-counter measurements.
DHAT heap live bytes are not native peak RSS.
Coreutils multi-call binaries may fail under Valgrind; compiled C probe passed.
validated: cachegrind with cache and branch simulation

predict_1000000.exactness_scope: CLI preview and aggregate only; complete f32 prediction audit is required separately

simulation.branch_model: Conditional: 16384 two-bit counters indexed by branch address/history. Indirect: 512-entry last-target predictor; returns assumed perfect. These simulated misses are not measurements of this CPU's predictor.
simulation.cache_model: Split I1 and D1 with unified LL; write allocate, bit-indexed sets, approximately inclusive LL. Exact simulated configuration is retained from events.out desc lines. This is not a complete modern CPU model.
simulation.instruction_caveat: REP-prefixed instruction iterations are counted separately, unlike the corresponding native hardware instruction event.

timing_policy: Profiler elapsed time retained only as run metadata; never use for native wall-time or Amdahl estimates.
